headword: {原子力発電|げんしりょくはつでん}
reading: げんしりょくはつでん

definitions.gloss: nuclear power generation; nuclear energy production
definitions.explanation: The generation of electricity using nuclear reactors. A major energy source in Japan, though controversial since the 2011 Fukushima disaster.
